entities.title: Entities
entities.description: A new instance always starts in shadow mode: it calculates but switches nothing.

data.indoor_entity: Indoor temperature (optional when a wall thermostat contact is given)
data.energy_factor: Boiler heat per unit (e.g. kWh per m³ of gas × efficiency)
data.extra_heat_entity: Other heat source energy (cumulative, e.g. air conditioner)
data.extra_factor: Heat per unit of the other source (e.g. COP)
data.boiler_power_kw: Boiler output (0 = heat need is not used in regulation)
data.zone_max_diff: Counts as part of the house if at most this much colder
data.flow_setpoint_entity: Flow setpoint entity (number / input_number, e.g. OpenTherm or ebusd)
data.valve_feedback_entity: Valve feedback (end switch or valve position, if there is one)
data.floor_max: Floor temperature limit (0 = by covering and probe position)
data.floor_hysteresis: Back on this far below the limit
data.onoff_hysteresis: Switch on this far below the target
data.power_available_entity: Controlled power signal (optional: on = power available)
data.floor_temper: Floor tempering (keep the floor warm even when the room is warm enough)
data.floor_temper_offset: Floor target above the room target (0 = by the floor covering)
data.floor_temper_night: Floor target at night / in the sleep preset (0 = as by day)
data.floor_temper_hysteresis: Tempering back on this far below the floor target
data.floor_temper_room_margin: No tempering once the room is this much above its target
data.floor_fallback: Lost room thermometer: keep the floor warm by the floor sensor
data.demand_entity: Wired wall thermostat contact (optional: on = it asks for heat)

data_description.reference_entity: Used by fault detection and the shadow comparison. If empty, the relay or thermostat.
data_description.heat_energy_entity: The heat need is learned from these and the temperatures. It needs at least 3 whole days, statistics count too.
data_description.valve_feedback_entity: The central boiler uses it to see whether the valve is really open (on/off, open/closed or at least 20 %). Empty or unavailable: it counts with the actuator opening time.
data_description.floor_entity: The thermometer in the floor. Required for electric floor heating: without it, or without a fresh reading, it does not heat.
data_description.floor_max: No heat above it, whatever the regulator says. 0 = by the covering and the sensor position: under the covering 29 °C for tiles, 27 °C for wood, laminate, vinyl, carpet; in the screed between the pipes 29 / 33 / 31 (vinyl) °C; above a supply pipe 36 °C. An electric floor always uses the under-covering value. Without a covering: 27 °C for an electric floor, 29 °C for a water floor.
data_description.target_source_entity: When someone changes its target (e.g. on the wall thermostat's knob), this instance takes it over as a manual target until the next scheduled change. What HC writes there itself is not taken over.
data_description.hp_defrost_entity: While on (or named defrost), fault detection waits and the run does not count as running without command.
data_description.hp_dhw_entity: A 3-way valve or a mode sensor: while it makes hot water the house waits, this is no fault.
data_description.floor_temper: Comfort: a warm floor. While the room is warm enough the floor is held at the room target + the offset (by the floor sensor); it stops when the room gets this much above its target. The floor limit always wins. Needs a floor sensor.
data_description.floor_fallback: Instead of the blind demand (or, for an electric floor, no heat) the floor is held at the room target + the tempering offset while the room thermometer is silent. Without a floor reading it works as before.
data_description.floor_covering: Gives the floor limit (with the sensor position) and the tempering offset: tiles 2 °C, other coverings 3 °C.
data_description.floor_probe: A sensor deeper in the screed reads warmer than the surface, so its limit is higher. The deeper positions' limits (screed 31–33 °C, above a pipe 36 °C) are estimates: they do not guarantee a surface below 27 °C. Under wood, parquet and laminate a sensor right under the covering (surface) is recommended.
data_description.demand_entity: A dry-contact wall thermostat read through a binary sensor, input boolean or switch: on = heat, off = no heat; then the room thermometer is optional. Frost, window, summer rest, the floor limit and floor tempering still apply. Unavailable: the lost-sensor fallback.
data_description.floor_temper_room_margin: Default 0.5 °C. A larger value gives a warmer floor, but the room swings further above its target and uses more energy.

central.title: Central boiler
central.description: Switches the boiler by the demand of the chosen zone thermostats; waits for actuator valves to open. Starts in shadow mode. With a modulating boiler, the zone asking the most sets the flow by its own curve.

data.confirm: I understand: active mode switches a real device
data.central_keep_alive_s: Resend the boiler's on state every (s, 0 = off)
data.central_pump_overrun_s: Pump overrun after the boiler stops (0 = off)
data.central_pump_bypass: Bypass / always-open circuit (the overrun needs no open valve)
data.flow_setpoint_entity: Flow setpoint (modulating boiler, optional: number / input_number)
data.central_flow_default: Flow when no zone asks for a value
data.central_pump_exercise_s: Weekly pump exercise: run time (0 = off)
data.central_pump_exercise_idle_days: Only when the pump has stood still for (days)

data_description.central_pump_exercise_s: With a pump entity: a pump that stood still for days runs alone for this long once a week, so it does not seize. Only while the boiler is off and no zone asks; the boiler does not start; not in the first minutes after a restart.

buffer.title: Buffer tank
buffer.description: Switches the heat source (pellet, heat pump, electric element) by the tank thermometers: the top below the lower limit starts it, the tank charges up to the upper limit. With zones given a new charge only starts while a zone asks for heat. Starts in shadow mode.

data.buffer_demand_led: Start a new charge only on zone demand
data.buffer_on: Charge starts when the top is this cold or colder
data.buffer_off: Charge stops when the bottom (or the top) reaches
data.buffer_frost: Frost: charge when the top falls below

data.yield_margin: While the other (cheaper) source heats the coupled zone, the boiler regulates this much below the target (0 = off)
data.assist_climate: House thermostat the AC helps when cheaper and the door is open (HC)

data.floor_hysteresis: Back on this far below the limit
data.onoff_hysteresis: Switch on this far below the target
data.load_limit_kw: Shared power limit of the electric zones (kW, 0 = none; the same on every zone)
data.floor_cooling: Floor cooling in summer (reversible heat pump)
data.cool_flow_entity: Cooling flow setpoint (optional; else the heating one)
data.dew_margin: Safety margin above the dew point

data.power_available_entity: Controlled power signal (optional: on = power available)
data.storage_discharge_hyst: Discharge starts this far below the target
data.fan_overrun_s: Fan overrun after the valve closes

data.return_max: Return limit (0 = none): the valve stays closed above it
data.return_hysteresis: Return limit releases this far below

data.floor_temper_offset: Floor target above the room target (0 = by the floor covering)
data.floor_temper_night: Floor target at night / in the sleep preset (0 = as by day)
data.floor_temper_hysteresis: Tempering back on this far below the floor target
data.floor_temper_room_margin: No tempering once the room is this much above its target
data.floor_fallback: Lost room thermometer: keep the floor warm by the floor sensor

data_description.zone_own_mixer: Off: the flow of a central modulating boiler never goes above the highest flow of this zone (flow_max, 45 °C for a floor by default) while its circuit can get water – radiator zones heat more weakly then. Switch it on only when the floor circuit really has a mixing valve or a temperature limiter.
data_description.valve_exercise: Once a week it opens a long-closed valve for a few minutes so it does not seize. The zone asks for no heat meanwhile, a central boiler does not start.
data_description.floor_entity: The thermometer in the floor. Required for electric floor heating: without it, or without a fresh reading, it does not heat.

data_description.floor_cooling: In summer (heating season off) the floor cools, but the water and the floor always stay above the dew point + margin, or moisture condenses. No cooling without humidity; on/off control also needs a floor sensor.

trv_rooms.title: TRV rooms
trv_rooms.description:
Per room: how much warmer (+) or cooler (−) than the house target – it still follows the schedule (night, away). Rooms: {rooms}.

Calibration: where the room has its own thermometer, the difference of the head's own (next to the radiator) reading is followed slowly and added to the target written to the head (at most ±5 °C, at most one write per half hour).

data.trv_calibration: Calibrate the heads by the room thermometers
